@app.cell(hide_code=True)
def _(mo):
    mo.md(r"""
    **Hypothesis.** The Q2 dip looks the same for every carrier type.
    Outcome: container, tanker and bulk each lose a similar share of
    their Q2 shipments from 2023 to 2024, each within 10 percentage
    points of the overall 28% drop.
    """)
    return


@app.cell(hide_code=True)
def dip_by_carrier_type(pl, shipments):
    _year = pl.col('ship_date').dt.year()
    _q2 = (
        shipments.filter(pl.col('ship_date').dt.quarter().eq(2))
        .group_by('carrier_type')
        .agg(
            q2_2023=_year.eq(2023).sum().cast(pl.Int64),
            q2_2024=_year.eq(2024).sum().cast(pl.Int64),
        )
        .with_columns(drop=pl.col('q2_2023').sub(pl.col('q2_2024')))
        .with_columns(
            pct_drop=pl.col('drop').truediv(pl.col('q2_2023')),
            share_of_drop=pl.col('drop').truediv(pl.col('drop').sum()),
        )
        .sort('drop', descending=True)
        .collect()
    )
    _q2
    return


@app.cell(hide_code=True)
def _(mo):
    mo.md(r"""
    **Facts.** Overall, Q2 shipments fell 28% (44 of 159). Container fell
    from 92 to 66, a drop of 26 or 28%, and 59% of the total drop. Tanker
    fell from 23 to 13, a drop of 10 or 43%, and 23% of the total drop.
    Bulk fell from 44 to 36, a drop of 8 or 18%, and 18% of the total drop.
    """)
    return
